name: DO NOT PASS
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend DO NOT PASS
meaning: Passing other vehicles is not allowed in this zone.

snippets.back: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk because it may hide a person crossing.
A broken centerline marks areas with no passing restriction, where you may pass when it is safe.
Do not pass a cyclist where the road is too narrow or the pass would force the rider dangerously close to parked vehicles.
Do not pass when approaching a curve or a hilltop where you cannot see far enough ahead to know passing is safe.
Do not pass if you cannot get back to the right side before a solid yellow line begins.

Turning drivers hunt for bikes and sidewalk children, never slice or shoulder riders off, expect wrong way wheels and sloppy wet handling, may pass safely inside no passing zones, and keep bike lanes, doors and reverse paths bike checked.
Stay out of motor-vehicle blind spots and do not pass a turning vehicle on the side toward which it is turning.
The NO PASSING ZONE warning sign stands on the left side of a two-lane road to warn where a no-passing zone begins.

evidence: sec08-card-sec08-F49 | AL p.50: The NO PASSING ZONE warning sign stands on the left side of a two-lane road to warn where a no-passing zone begins.
result.summary: No snippet names, describes, or defines the DO NOT PASS sign. The only sign-related snippet describes a different NO PASSING ZONE warning sign, and other snippets state general no-passing rules without linking them to the DO NOT PASS sign.
